primary: Mean actor-minus-base released-terminal success over all five locked training seeds and all 100 fresh scenes.
interval: Crossed bootstrap resampling scenes and training seeds independently; percentile 95% interval; paired differences share the same base.
inference_seeds: One Gaussian stream seeded with each scene ID, shared across all arms.
score_window: Last eight control ticks of a fixed 200-tick episode, or until cube drop. No early success termination.
